```{r}
          h3("Estimated CD Value at Maturity"),
          plotOutput("sim_plot", height = "380px")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Simulation Table"),
          tableOutput("sim_table"),
          p(
            "Due to the illiquidity of CDs, the rate at which a CD is opened cannot change. Calculating its value at maturity is done by using the rate observed at the date it is opened. If the investment date selected is outside the scope of the data, the corresponding rate is determined from the forecasting model selected."
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Server
# -----------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  explore_base <- reactive({
    req(input$explore_terms)

    cd |>
      filter(
        term %in% input$explore_terms,
        date >= yearmonth(input$date_range[1]),
        date <= yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
      )
  })

  output$latest_date_summary <- renderText({
    as.character(max_date)
  })

  output$highest_latest_rate_summary <- renderText({
    latest <- cd |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(date == max_date) |>
      arrange(desc(rate)) |>
      slice(1)

    paste0(round(latest$rate, 2), "%")
  })

  output$direction_summary <- renderText({
    latest_two <- cd |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(term == "12 Month") |>
      arrange(date) |>
      slice_tail(n = 2)

    if (latest_two$rate[2] > latest_two$rate[1]) {
      "Rising"
    } else if (latest_two$rate[2] < latest_two$rate[1]) {
      "Falling"
    } else {
      "Flat"
    }
  })

  output$core_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- explore_base()
    plot_data <- if (input$use_sa) seasonally_adjust_cd(data) else data

    plot_data |>
      autoplot(rate, linewidth = 1.05) +
      labs(
        title = ifelse(
          input$use_sa,
          "Seasonally Adjusted National Average CD Rates",
          "National Average CD Rates"
        ),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate (%)",
        color = "Term"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563", "#9ca3af")) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$seasonal_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- explore_base()
    plot_data <- if (input$use_detrended) detrend_cd(data) else data

    plot_data |>
      gg_season(rate, labels = "both") +
      labs(
        title = ifelse(
          input$use_detrended,
          "Detrended Seasonal Plot",
          "Seasonal Plot"
        ),
        x = "Month",
        y = "Rate (%)",
        color = "Year"
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$spread_plot <- renderPlot({
    spread_data <- cd |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(
        date >= yearmonth(input$date_range[1]),
        date <= yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
      ) |>
      select(date, term, rate) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = rate) |>
      mutate(
        `24 minus 6 Month` = `24 Month` - `6 Month`,
        `12 minus 6 Month` = `12 Month` - `6 Month`
      ) |>
      select(date, `24 minus 6 Month`, `12 minus 6 Month`) |>
      pivot_longer(
        -date,
        names_to = "spread",
        values_to = "value"
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(value))

    ggplot(spread_data, aes(x = date, y = value, color = spread)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
      labs(
        title = "CD Term Spreads",
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate spread, percentage points",
        color = "Spread"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563")) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$decomp_plot <- renderPlot({
    one_series <- cd |>
      filter(term == input$decomp_term) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(date, rate) |>
      arrange(date) |>
      as_tsibble(index = date)

    if (input$decomp_type == "STL") {
      fit <- one_series |>
        model(STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
        components()
    } else {
      fit <- one_series |>
        model(classical_decomposition(rate, type = "additive")) |>
        components()
    }

    autoplot(fit) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          input$decomp_type,
          "decomposition for",
          input$decomp_term,
          "CD rates"
        )
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  forecast_results <- reactive({
    fit_forecast_models(
      cd,
      input$forecast_term,
      input$holdout,
      input$horizon
    )
  })

  output$selected_model_summary <- renderText({
    input$forecast_model
  })

  output$best_model_summary <- renderText({
    forecast_results()$accuracy$.model[1]
  })

  output$horizon_summary <- renderText({
    paste0(input$horizon, " mo.")
  })

  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- forecast_results()

    model_to_show <- input$forecast_model

    fc <- res$future_fc |>
      filter(.model == model_to_show)

    history <- cd |>
      filter(term == input$forecast_term) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(date, rate) |>
      arrange(date) |>
      as_tsibble(index = date)

    autoplot(fc, history) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          model_to_show,
          "forecast for",
          input$forecast_term,
          "CD rates"
        ),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate (%)"
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$accuracy_table <- renderTable({
    forecast_results()$accuracy |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(.model, ME, RMSE, MAE) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
  })

  output$forecast_recommendation <- renderText({
    acc <- forecast_results()$accuracy
    best <- acc$.model[1]

    paste0(
      "Recommended model based on current holdout: ", best, "\n\n",
      "Reason: it has the lowest RMSE on the selected holdout period. RMSE is useful here because CD rates are measured in percentage points and larger errors are penalized more heavily. Still, the recommendation can change if the holdout size changes, so the app allows sensitivity checks. A holdout size of 8, 9, 10, and 16 months favors the Naive model, whereas everything else in the 6-18 month range favors ARIMA."
    )
  })

  sim_data <- reactive({
    invest_ym <- yearmonth(input$invest_date)

    sim_rates <- get_simulation_rates(
      data = cd,
      invest_ym = invest_ym,
      selected_model = input$sim_model
    )

    validate(
      need(nrow(sim_rates) > 0, "No rates are available for the selected investment month.")
    )

    sim_rates |>
      mutate(
        term_months = as.numeric(str_extract(as.character(term), "\\d+")),
        initial_amount = input$initial_amount,
        maturity_value = initial_amount * (1 + rate / 100 / 12) ^ term_months,
        interest_earned = maturity_value - initial_amount
      )
  })

  output$sim_plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(sim_data(), aes(x = term, y = maturity_value, fill = term)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = dollar(round(maturity_value, 2))),
        vjust = -0.4,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Projected Value at CD Maturity",
          ifelse(
            yearmonth(input$invest_date) > max_date,
            paste("using", input$sim_model, "forecasted rates"),
            "using observed historical rates"
          )
        ),
        x = "CD Term",
        y = "Maturity value"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563", "#9ca3af")) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$sim_table <- renderTable({
    sim_data() |>
      transmute(
        Term = term,
        `Investment Month` = as.character(date),
        `Rate Source` = rate_source,
        `Rate (%)` = round(rate, 3),
        `Initial Amount` = dollar(initial_amount),
        `Estimated Maturity Value` = dollar(round(maturity_value, 2)),
        `Estimated Interest Earned` = dollar(round(interest_earned, 2))
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(fpp3)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Data preparation
# -----------------------------

read_fred_cd <- function(series_id, term_months) {
  url <- paste0("https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=", series_id)

  read.csv(url) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(
      date = yearmonth(observation_date),
      term = term_months,
      rate = .data[[series_id]]
    ) |>
    select(date, term, rate) |>
    filter(
      date >= yearmonth("2021 Apr"),
      date <= yearmonth("2026 Apr"),
      !is.na(rate)
    )
}

cd <- bind_rows(
  read_fred_cd("NDR6MCD", 6),
  read_fred_cd("NDR12MCD", 12),
  read_fred_cd("NDR24MCD", 24)
) |>
  mutate(
    term = factor(
      term,
      levels = c(6, 12, 24),
      labels = c("6 Month", "12 Month", "24 Month")
    )
  ) |>
  as_tsibble(index = date, key = term)

min_date <- min(cd$date)
max_date <- max(cd$date)
max_future_date <- max_date + 24
term_choices <- levels(cd$term)
model_choices <- c("Mean", "ARIMA", "TSLM", "Naive")

# -----------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# -----------------------------

months_between <- function(start_ym, end_ym) {
  start_date <- as.Date(start_ym)
  end_date <- as.Date(end_ym)

  12 * (year(end_date) - year(start_date)) +
    (month(end_date) - month(start_date))
}

seasonally_adjust_cd <- function(data) {
  data |>
    model(stl = STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
    components() |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(date, term, rate = season_adjust) |>
    as_tsibble(index = date, key = term)
}

detrend_cd <- function(data) {
  data |>
    model(stl = STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
    components() |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(date, term, rate = rate - trend) |>
    as_tsibble(index = date, key = term)
}

fit_forecast_models <- function(data, selected_term, holdout_size, horizon) {
  one_series <- data |>
    filter(term == selected_term) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(date, rate) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    as_tsibble(index = date)

  req(holdout_size < nrow(one_series))

  train_n <- nrow(one_series) - holdout_size

  train <- one_series |>
    slice_head(n = train_n)

  test <- one_series |>
    slice_tail(n = holdout_size)

  fits <- train |>
    model(
      Mean = MEAN(rate),
      Naive = NAIVE(rate),
      ARIMA = ARIMA(rate),
      TSLM = TSLM(rate ~ trend() + season())
    )

  test_fc <- fits |>
    forecast(h = holdout_size)

  future_fc <- fits |>
    forecast(h = horizon)

  acc <- test_fc |>
    accuracy(test) |>
    arrange(RMSE)

  list(
    train = train,
    test = test,
    fits = fits,
    test_fc = test_fc,
    future_fc = future_fc,
    accuracy = acc
  )
}

get_simulation_rates <- function(data, invest_ym, selected_model) {
  if (invest_ym <= max_date) {
    data |>
      filter(date == invest_ym) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      mutate(rate_source = "Observed historical rate")
  } else {
    h_needed <- months_between(max_date, invest_ym)

    fits <- data |>
      model(
        Mean = MEAN(rate),
        Naive = NAIVE(rate),
        ARIMA = ARIMA(rate),
        TSLM = TSLM(rate ~ trend() + season())
      )

    fits |>
      forecast(h = h_needed) |>
      filter(.model == selected_model, date == invest_ym) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      transmute(
        date,
        term,
        rate = .mean,
        rate_source = paste(selected_model, "forecast")
      )
  }
}

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#6b7280"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e5e7eb"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

        ),

          "holdout",
          "Holdout test size, in months:",
          min = 6,
          max = 18,
          value = 12,
          step = 1
        ),
        radioButtons(
          "forecast_model",
          "Model to emphasize:",
          choices = model_choices,
          selected = "Mean"
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        fluidRow(
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Selected Model"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("selected_model_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Best RMSE Model"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("best_model_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Forecast Horizon"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("horizon_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          )
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Forecast Plot"),
          plotOutput("forecast_plot", height = "420px")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Accuracy Table on Holdout Set"),
          tableOutput("accuracy_table")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Recommendation"),
          verbatimTextOutput("forecast_recommendation")
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Simulator",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        dateInput(
          "invest_date",
          "Date invested:",
          value = as.Date(max_date),
          min = as.Date(min_date),
          max = as.Date(max_future_date)
        ),
        radioButtons(
          "sim_model",
          "Forecast model for future dates:",
          choices = model_choices,
          selected = "Mean"
        ),
        numericInput(
          "initial_amount",
          "Initial amount invested:",
          value = 1000,
          min = 1,
          step = 100
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Estimated CD Value at Maturity"),
          plotOutput("sim_plot", height = "380px")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Simulation Table"),
          tableOutput("sim_table"),
          p(
            "Due to the illiquidity of CDs, the rate at which a CD is opened cannot change. Calculating its value at maturity is done by using the rate observed at the date it is opened. If the investment date selected is outside the scope of the data, the corresponding rate is determined from the forecasting model selected."
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Server
# -----------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  explore_base <- reactive({
    req(input$explore_terms)

    cd |>
      filter(
        term %in% input$explore_terms,
        date >= yearmonth(input$date_range[1]),
        date <= yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
      )
  })

  output$latest_date_summary <- renderText({
    max(explore_base()$date) |> as.character()
  })

  output$highest_latest_rate_summary <- renderText({
    data <- explore_base()

    latest <- data |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(date == max(date)) |>
      arrange(desc(rate)) |>
      slice(1)

    paste0(round(latest$rate, 2), "%")
  })

  output$direction_summary <- renderText({
    data <- explore_base()

    latest_two <- data |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(term == "12 Month") |>
      arrange(date) |>
      slice_tail(n = 2)

    if (nrow(latest_two) < 2) {
      return("N/A")
    }

    if (latest_two$rate[2] > latest_two$rate[1]) {
      "Rising"
    } else if (latest_two$rate[2] < latest_two$rate[1]) {
      "Falling"
    } else {
      "Flat"
    }
  })

  output$core_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- explore_base()
    plot_data <- if (input$use_sa) seasonally_adjust_cd(data) else data

    plot_data |>
      autoplot(rate, linewidth = 1.05) +
      labs(
        title = ifelse(
          input$use_sa,
          "Seasonally Adjusted National Average CD Rates",
          "National Average CD Rates"
        ),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate (%)",
        color = "Term"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563", "#9ca3af")) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$seasonal_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- explore_base()
    plot_data <- if (input$use_detrended) detrend_cd(data) else data

    plot_data |>
      gg_season(rate, labels = "both") +
      labs(
        title = ifelse(
          input$use_detrended,
          "Detrended Seasonal Plot",
          "Seasonal Plot"
        ),
        x = "Month",
        y = "Rate (%)",
        color = "Year"
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$spread_plot <- renderPlot({
    spread_data <- cd |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(
        date >= yearmonth(input$date_range[1]),
        date <= yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
      ) |>
      select(date, term, rate) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = rate) |>
      mutate(
        `24 minus 6 Month` = `24 Month` - `6 Month`,
        `12 minus 6 Month` = `12 Month` - `6 Month`
      ) |>
      select(date, `24 minus 6 Month`, `12 minus 6 Month`) |>
      pivot_longer(
        -date,
        names_to = "spread",
        values_to = "value"
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(value))

    ggplot(spread_data, aes(x = date, y = value, color = spread)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
      labs(
        title = "CD Term Spreads",
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate spread, percentage points",
        color = "Spread"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563")) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$decomp_plot <- renderPlot({
    one_series <- cd |>
      filter(term == input$decomp_term) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(date, rate) |>
      arrange(date) |>
      as_tsibble(index = date)

    if (input$decomp_type == "STL") {
      fit <- one_series |>
        model(STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
        components()
    } else {
      fit <- one_series |>
        model(classical_decomposition(rate, type = "additive")) |>
        components()
    }

    autoplot(fit) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          input$decomp_type,
          "decomposition for",
          input$decomp_term,
          "CD rates"
        )
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  forecast_results <- reactive({
    fit_forecast_models(
      cd,
      input$forecast_term,
      input$holdout,
      input$horizon
    )
  })

  output$selected_model_summary <- renderText({
    input$forecast_model
  })

  output$best_model_summary <- renderText({
    forecast_results()$accuracy$.model[1]
  })

  output$horizon_summary <- renderText({
    paste0(input$horizon, " mo.")
  })

  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- forecast_results()

    model_to_show <- input$forecast_model

    fc <- res$future_fc |>
      filter(.model == model_to_show)

    history <- cd |>
      filter(term == input$forecast_term) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(date, rate) |>
      arrange(date) |>
      as_tsibble(index = date)

    autoplot(fc, history) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          model_to_show,
          "forecast for",
          input$forecast_term,
          "CD rates"
        ),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate (%)"
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$accuracy_table <- renderTable({
    forecast_results()$accuracy |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(.model, ME, RMSE, MAE) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
  })

  output$forecast_recommendation <- renderText({
    acc <- forecast_results()$accuracy
    best <- acc$.model[1]

    paste0(
      "Recommended model based on current holdout: ", best, "\n\n",
      "Reason: it has the lowest RMSE on the selected holdout period. RMSE is useful here because CD rates are measured in percentage points and larger errors are penalized more heavily. Still, the recommendation can change if the holdout size changes, so the app allows sensitivity checks. A holdout size of 8, 9, 10, and 16 months favors the Naive model, whereas everything else in the 6-18 month range favors ARIMA."
    )
  })

  sim_data <- reactive({
    invest_ym <- yearmonth(input$invest_date)

    sim_rates <- get_simulation_rates(
      data = cd,
      invest_ym = invest_ym,
      selected_model = input$sim_model
    )

    validate(
      need(nrow(sim_rates) > 0, "No rates are available for the selected investment month.")
    )

    sim_rates |>
      mutate(
        term_months = as.numeric(str_extract(as.character(term), "\\d+")),
        initial_amount = input$initial_amount,
        maturity_value = initial_amount * (1 + rate / 100 / 12) ^ term_months,
        interest_earned = maturity_value - initial_amount
      )
  })

  output$sim_plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(sim_data(), aes(x = term, y = maturity_value, fill = term)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = dollar(round(maturity_value, 2))),
        vjust = -0.4,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Projected Value at CD Maturity",
          ifelse(
            yearmonth(input$invest_date) > max_date,
            paste("using", input$sim_model, "forecasted rates"),
            "using observed historical rates"
          )
        ),
        x = "CD Term",
        y = "Maturity value"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563", "#9ca3af")) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$sim_table <- renderTable({
    sim_data() |>
      transmute(
        Term = term,
        `Investment Month` = as.character(date),
        `Rate Source` = rate_source,
        `Rate (%)` = round(rate, 3),
        `Initial Amount` = dollar(initial_amount),
        `Estimated Maturity Value` = dollar(round(maturity_value, 2)),
        `Estimated Interest Earned` = dollar(round(interest_earned, 2))
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(fpp3)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Data preparation
# -----------------------------

read_fred_cd <- function(series_id, term_months) {
  url <- paste0("https://fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=", series_id)

  read.csv(url) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(
      date = yearmonth(observation_date),
      term = term_months,
      rate = .data[[series_id]]
    ) |>
    select(date, term, rate) |>
    filter(
      date >= yearmonth("2021 Apr"),
      date <= yearmonth("2026 Apr"),
      !is.na(rate)
    )
}

cd <- bind_rows(
  read_fred_cd("NDR6MCD", 6),
  read_fred_cd("NDR12MCD", 12),
  read_fred_cd("NDR24MCD", 24)
) |>
  mutate(
    term = factor(
      term,
      levels = c(6, 12, 24),
      labels = c("6 Month", "12 Month", "24 Month")
    )
  ) |>
  as_tsibble(index = date, key = term)

min_date <- min(cd$date)
max_date <- max(cd$date)
max_future_date <- max_date + 24
term_choices <- levels(cd$term)
model_choices <- c("Mean", "ARIMA", "TSLM", "Naive", "Ensemble")

# -----------------------------
# 2. Helper functions
# -----------------------------

months_between <- function(start_ym, end_ym) {
  start_date <- as.Date(start_ym)
  end_date <- as.Date(end_ym)

  12 * (year(end_date) - year(start_date)) +
    (month(end_date) - month(start_date))
}

seasonally_adjust_cd <- function(data) {
  data |>
    model(stl = STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
    components() |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(date, term, rate = season_adjust) |>
    as_tsibble(index = date, key = term)
}

detrend_cd <- function(data) {
  data |>
    model(stl = STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
    components() |>
    as_tibble() |>
    transmute(date, term, rate = rate - trend) |>
    as_tsibble(index = date, key = term)
}

fit_forecast_models <- function(data, selected_term, holdout_size, horizon) {
  one_series <- data |>
    filter(term == selected_term) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(date, rate) |>
    arrange(date) |>
    as_tsibble(index = date)

  req(holdout_size < nrow(one_series))

  train_n <- nrow(one_series) - holdout_size

  train <- one_series |>
    slice_head(n = train_n)

  test <- one_series |>
    slice_tail(n = holdout_size)

  fits <- train |>
    model(
      Mean = MEAN(rate),
      Naive = NAIVE(rate),
      ARIMA = ARIMA(rate),
      TSLM = TSLM(rate ~ trend() + season())
    )

  test_fc_base <- fits |>
    forecast(h = holdout_size) |>
    as_tibble()

  future_fc_base <- fits |>
    forecast(h = horizon) |>
    as_tibble()

  test_fc_ensemble <- test_fc_base |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(
      .model = "Ensemble",
      .mean = mean(.mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  future_fc_ensemble <- future_fc_base |>
    group_by(date) |>
    summarise(
      .model = "Ensemble",
      .mean = mean(.mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  test_fc <- bind_rows(
    test_fc_base |> select(.model, date, .mean),
    test_fc_ensemble
  )

  future_fc <- bind_rows(
    future_fc_base |> select(.model, date, .mean),
    future_fc_ensemble
  )

  acc <- test_fc |>
    left_join(test |> as_tibble(), by = "date") |>
    group_by(.model) |>
    summarise(
      ME = mean(rate - .mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      RMSE = sqrt(mean((rate - .mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MAE = mean(abs(rate - .mean), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(RMSE)

  list(
    train = train,
    test = test,
    fits = fits,
    test_fc = test_fc,
    future_fc = future_fc,
    accuracy = acc
  )
}

get_simulation_rates <- function(data, invest_ym, selected_model) {
  if (invest_ym <= max_date) {
    data |>
      filter(date == invest_ym) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      mutate(rate_source = "Observed historical rate")
  } else {
    h_needed <- months_between(max_date, invest_ym)

    fits <- data |>
      model(
        Mean = MEAN(rate),
        Naive = NAIVE(rate),
        ARIMA = ARIMA(rate),
        TSLM = TSLM(rate ~ trend() + season())
      )

    fc_base <- fits |>
      forecast(h = h_needed) |>
      as_tibble()

    fc_ensemble <- fc_base |>
      group_by(term, date) |>
      summarise(
        .model = "Ensemble",
        .mean = mean(.mean, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    fc_all <- bind_rows(
      fc_base |> select(.model, date, term, .mean),
      fc_ensemble
    )

    fc_all |>
      filter(.model == selected_model, date == invest_ym) |>
      transmute(
        date,
        term,
        rate = .mean,
        rate_source = paste(selected_model, "forecast")
      )
  }
}

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#6b7280"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e5e7eb"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

          max = as.Date(max_date),
          value = c(as.Date(min_date), as.Date(max_date)),
          timeFormat = "%b %Y"
        ),
        checkboxInput(
          "use_sa",
          "Seasonally adjust core time series",
          value = FALSE
        ),
        checkboxInput(
          "use_detrended",
          "Detrend seasonal visualization",
          value = FALSE
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        fluidRow(
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Latest Date"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("latest_date_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Highest Latest Rate"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("highest_latest_rate_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Current Direction"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("direction_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          )
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Core Time Series Plot"),
          plotOutput("core_plot", height = "360px"),
          p(
            "Each series follows a similar trend and general movement, starting at or near zero in 2021, reflecting the low rates associated with the post-COVID economy. In early 2022, each rises sharply, possibly aligning with the aggressive Fed tightening and rapid repricing of short term investment options at the time. Counterintuitively, rates of longer term options do not increase more rapidly than those of shorter terms. In other words, longer term CDs typically do not offer higher rates, especially at their respective peaks. However, this difference in rate begins to converge in more recent observations following the conversion to a downward trend, leading to the assumption that the current market is expecting rates to decline in the future."
          )
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Seasonal Plot"),
          plotOutput("seasonal_plot", height = "360px"),
          p(
            "Rates do not exhibit any true seasonality as the plot reveals no similar movements or values within similar times in the year. This inconsistent pattern suggests that changes that appear to correspond in time may be caused by the similar timing of external political or economic factors, not rates themselves. This is an important insight, but it does not indicate true seasonality."
          )
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Term Spread"),
          plotOutput("spread_plot", height = "320px"),
          p(
            "Higher points in the line indicate a greater difference in rates paid on the respective shorter and longer term CDs, such as 6 month versus 12 month and 6 month versus 24 month CDs. As the plot moves closer to zero, represented by the dashed line, the benefit of a longer term decreases. The upward trend on the left side and its change to a downward trend verifies the observations in the core plot, revealing the diminishing benefit of longer term CDs since the peak, along with the convergence of rates in more recent observations."
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Decompose",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput(
          "decomp_term",
          "Select CD term:",
          choices = term_choices,
          selected = "12 Month"
        ),
        radioButtons(
          "decomp_type",
          "Decomposition method:",
          choices = c("STL", "Classical"),
          selected = "STL"
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          plotOutput("decomp_plot", height = "620px"),
          p(
            strong("Interpretation guide:"),
            " STL decomposition performs slightly better than classical decomposition. The series shows a sharp increasing trend that converts into a mild to moderate downward trend. Seasonality is practically non-existent, indicated by the minuscule range in the seasonal component."
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Forecast",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        selectInput(
          "forecast_term",
          "Select CD term:",
          choices = term_choices,
          selected = "12 Month"
        ),
        sliderInput(
          "horizon",
          "Forecast horizon, in months:",
          min = 3,
          max = 24,
          value = 12,
          step = 1
        ),
        sliderInput(
          "holdout",
          "Holdout test size, in months:",
          min = 6,
          max = 18,
          value = 12,
          step = 1
        ),
        radioButtons(
          "forecast_model",
          "Model to emphasize:",
          choices = model_choices,
          selected = "Ensemble"
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        fluidRow(
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Selected Model"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("selected_model_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Best RMSE Model"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("best_model_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(
              class = "summary-card",
              div(class = "summary-label", "Forecast Horizon"),
              div(class = "summary-value", textOutput("horizon_summary", inline = TRUE))
            )
          )
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Forecast Plot"),
          plotOutput("forecast_plot", height = "420px")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Accuracy Table on Holdout Set"),
          tableOutput("accuracy_table")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Recommendation"),
          verbatimTextOutput("forecast_recommendation")
        )
      )
    )
  ),

  tabPanel(
    "Simulator",
    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        dateInput(
          "invest_date",
          "Date invested:",
          value = as.Date(max_date),
          min = as.Date(min_date),
          max = as.Date(max_future_date)
        ),
        radioButtons(
          "sim_model",
          "Forecast model for future dates:",
          choices = model_choices,
          selected = "Ensemble"
        ),
        numericInput(
          "initial_amount",
          "Initial amount invested:",
          value = 1000,
          min = 1,
          step = 100
        )
      ),
      mainPanel(
        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Estimated CD Value at Maturity"),
          plotOutput("sim_plot", height = "380px")
        ),

        div(
          class = "main-panel-card",
          h3("Simulation Table"),
          tableOutput("sim_table"),
          p(
            "Due to the illiquidity of CDs, the rate at which a CD is opened cannot change. Calculating its value at maturity is done by using the rate observed at the date it is opened. If the investment date selected is outside the scope of the data, the corresponding rate is determined from the forecasting model selected."
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Server
# -----------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  explore_base <- reactive({
    req(input$explore_terms)

    cd |>
      filter(
        term %in% input$explore_terms,
        date >= yearmonth(input$date_range[1]),
        date <= yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
      )
  })

  output$latest_date_summary <- renderText({
    max(explore_base()$date) |> as.character()
  })

  output$highest_latest_rate_summary <- renderText({
    data <- explore_base()

    latest <- data |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(date == max(date)) |>
      arrange(desc(rate)) |>
      slice(1)

    paste0(round(latest$rate, 2), "%")
  })

  output$direction_summary <- renderText({
    data <- explore_base()

    latest_two <- data |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(term == "12 Month") |>
      arrange(date) |>
      slice_tail(n = 2)

    if (nrow(latest_two) < 2) {
      return("N/A")
    }

    if (latest_two$rate[2] > latest_two$rate[1]) {
      "Rising"
    } else if (latest_two$rate[2] < latest_two$rate[1]) {
      "Falling"
    } else {
      "Flat"
    }
  })

  output$core_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- explore_base()
    plot_data <- if (input$use_sa) seasonally_adjust_cd(data) else data

    plot_data |>
      autoplot(rate, linewidth = 1.05) +
      labs(
        title = ifelse(
          input$use_sa,
          "Seasonally Adjusted National Average CD Rates",
          "National Average CD Rates"
        ),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate (%)",
        color = "Term"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563", "#9ca3af")) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$seasonal_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- explore_base()
    plot_data <- if (input$use_detrended) detrend_cd(data) else data

    plot_data |>
      gg_season(rate, labels = "both") +
      labs(
        title = ifelse(
          input$use_detrended,
          "Detrended Seasonal Plot",
          "Seasonal Plot"
        ),
        x = "Month",
        y = "Rate (%)",
        color = "Year"
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$spread_plot <- renderPlot({
    spread_data <- cd |>
      as_tibble() |>
      filter(
        date >= yearmonth(input$date_range[1]),
        date <= yearmonth(input$date_range[2])
      ) |>
      select(date, term, rate) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = rate) |>
      mutate(
        `24 minus 6 Month` = `24 Month` - `6 Month`,
        `12 minus 6 Month` = `12 Month` - `6 Month`
      ) |>
      select(date, `24 minus 6 Month`, `12 minus 6 Month`) |>
      pivot_longer(
        -date,
        names_to = "spread",
        values_to = "value"
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(value))

    ggplot(spread_data, aes(x = date, y = value, color = spread)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
      labs(
        title = "CD Term Spreads",
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate spread, percentage points",
        color = "Spread"
      ) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563")) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$decomp_plot <- renderPlot({
    one_series <- cd |>
      filter(term == input$decomp_term) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(date, rate) |>
      arrange(date) |>
      as_tsibble(index = date)

    if (input$decomp_type == "STL") {
      fit <- one_series |>
        model(STL(rate ~ season(window = "periodic"))) |>
        components()
    } else {
      fit <- one_series |>
        model(classical_decomposition(rate, type = "additive")) |>
        components()
    }

    autoplot(fit) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          input$decomp_type,
          "decomposition for",
          input$decomp_term,
          "CD rates"
        )
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  forecast_results <- reactive({
    fit_forecast_models(
      cd,
      input$forecast_term,
      input$holdout,
      input$horizon
    )
  })

  output$selected_model_summary <- renderText({
    input$forecast_model
  })

  output$best_model_summary <- renderText({
    forecast_results()$accuracy$.model[1]
  })

  output$horizon_summary <- renderText({
    paste0(input$horizon, " mo.")
  })

  output$forecast_plot <- renderPlot({
    res <- forecast_results()

    model_to_show <- input$forecast_model

    fc <- res$future_fc |>
      filter(.model == model_to_show)

    history <- cd |>
      filter(term == input$forecast_term) |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(date, rate) |>
      arrange(date)

    ggplot() +
      geom_line(
        data = history,
        aes(x = date, y = rate),
        linewidth = 1.05,
        color = "#4b5563"
      ) +
      geom_line(
        data = fc,
        aes(x = date, y = .mean),
        linewidth = 1.15,
        color = "#ff8200"
      ) +
      geom_point(
        data = fc,
        aes(x = date, y = .mean),
        size = 2,
        color = "#ff8200"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          model_to_show,
          "forecast for",
          input$forecast_term,
          "CD rates"
        ),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Rate (%)"
      ) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$accuracy_table <- renderTable({
    forecast_results()$accuracy |>
      as_tibble() |>
      select(.model, ME, RMSE, MAE) |>
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4)))
  })

  output$forecast_recommendation <- renderText({
    acc <- forecast_results()$accuracy
    best <- acc$.model[1]

    paste0(
      "Recommended model based on current holdout: ", best, "\n\n",
      "Reason: it has the lowest RMSE on the selected holdout period. RMSE is useful here because CD rates are measured in percentage points and larger errors are penalized more heavily. The Ensemble model averages the Mean, Naive, ARIMA, and TSLM forecasts, which can make the forecast more stable by reducing dependence on a single model assumption. However, because CD rates are highly persistent, ARIMA and Naive may still outperform the Ensemble in some holdout windows.","\n\n","Tip: The Ensemble Model is a combination of Mean, Naive, ARIMA, and TSLM models by averaging their predicted values. Rather than relying on just one method, this model increases stability and limits the forecast's dependence on a singular model's accuracy."
    )
  })

  sim_data <- reactive({
    invest_ym <- yearmonth(input$invest_date)

    sim_rates <- get_simulation_rates(
      data = cd,
      invest_ym = invest_ym,
      selected_model = input$sim_model
    )

    validate(
      need(nrow(sim_rates) > 0, "No rates are available for the selected investment month.")
    )

    sim_rates |>
      mutate(
        term_months = as.numeric(str_extract(as.character(term), "\\d+")),
        initial_amount = input$initial_amount,
        maturity_value = initial_amount * (1 + rate / 100 / 12) ^ term_months,
        interest_earned = maturity_value - initial_amount
      )
  })

  output$sim_plot <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(sim_data(), aes(x = term, y = maturity_value, fill = term)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = dollar(round(maturity_value, 2))),
        vjust = -0.4,
        fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Projected Value at CD Maturity",
          ifelse(
            yearmonth(input$invest_date) > max_date,
            paste("using", input$sim_model, "forecasted rates"),
            "using observed historical rates"
          )
        ),
        x = "CD Term",
        y = "Maturity value"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("#ff8200", "#4b5563", "#9ca3af")) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
      plot_theme
  })

  output$sim_table <- renderTable({
    sim_data() |>
      transmute(
        Term = term,
        `Investment Month` = as.character(date),
        `Rate Source` = rate_source,
        `Rate (%)` = round(rate, 3),
        `Initial Amount` = dollar(initial_amount),
        `Estimated Maturity Value` = dollar(round(maturity_value, 2)),
        `Estimated Interest Earned` = dollar(round(interest_earned, 2))
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
